name: Reading digest
description: Summarize the circle's recent notes into a digest report, with a little outside context on the book.

toolsets.reason: Save a Word copy of the digest for members who read it away from gezel.

steps.name: Gather
steps.prompt: Use read_file on circle.json and on every notes/ file from the last two weeks. Collect what the circle actually discussed: themes, disagreements, favorite passages. Then search once or twice (web_search, or wikipedia_search when no web search provider is set up) for reception or background on the current book worth one short paragraph. Keep working notes with write_task_note.

steps.name: Write the digest
steps.prompt: Write the digest with write_artifact to reports/reading-digest.md. Sections: What we read, What we said (grounded in the notes, quoting members only where the notes quote them), A little context (from the search), and Questions for next time. Keep it under a page. If the DocBlocks tools are available, also make a Word copy: convert that markdown with convert_document and save it with save_artifact as reports/reading-digest.docx.
